name: Unbound Container Hooks
description: Installs the canonical Unbound hooks (sourced from this repo's claude-code/hooks/unbound.py and cursor/unbound.py) plus managed settings so Claude Code and Cursor running in this dev container enforce Unbound policy. Claude Code gets /unbound/unbound.py + /etc/claude-code managed settings; Cursor gets the enterprise-managed hooks at /etc/cursor (the same layout cursor/mdm/setup.py installs on Linux). Both resolve credentials at runtime via their env key (UNBOUND_CLAUDE_API_KEY / UNBOUND_CURSOR_API_KEY) or a mounted ~/.unbound/config.json, and call the Unbound gateway. Requires python3 (installed via the official python feature) and curl (installed best-effort).
